fm.title: Interaction
fm.description: Forces, contacts, and constraint interactions (4 blocks)

rows.intent: Apply kinematic constraints between bodies — use for locking degrees of freedom, enforcing geometric relationships, or creating closed-loop mechanisms
Define contact geometry for collision detection — use for modeling rolling, sliding, or impact interactions between curved surfaces in multibody systems
Apply external forces and torques to bodies — use for modeling gravity, springs, dampers, actuators, or any applied load in a multibody system
Interface Simscape Multibody with Simscape physical networks — use for connecting 3D mechanical models to 1D driveline or other Simscape domain models

fm.title: Motion
fm.description: Joints, gears, and kinematic connections between bodies (3 blocks)

rows.intent: Model flexible belt and cable connections between pulleys — use for power transmission systems like timing belts, V-belts, or cable-driven mechanisms
Model gear pairs and mechanical couplings — use for spur gears, bevel gears, worm drives, or other power transmission couplings between shafts
Connect bodies with degrees of freedom — use for revolute, prismatic, spherical, or other articulated connections in a multibody mechanism

fm.title: Structure
fm.description: Rigid body definition and spatial reference frames (3 blocks)

rows.intent: Define rigid body geometry, inertia, and visual properties — use for creating the physical bodies that make up a multibody mechanism
Define coordinate frames and spatial transformations — use for positioning, orienting, and relating reference frames within a multibody assembly
Utility blocks for multibody modeling — use for mechanism configuration, variable sensing, or solver settings in Simscape Multibody models
